objective: Build a classic two-player tic-tac-toe game as ONE self-contained file index.html (inline <style> and <script>, no external URLs or assets). Required DOM hooks: nine <button> elements with ids cell-0 to cell-8 in row-major order whose text is "X", "O" or empty; an element with id="status" whose text names the player to move ("X" or "O"), then announces the winner (e.g. "X wins") or a draw ("Draw"); a button with id="restart". Rules: X moves first; turns alternate; clicking an occupied cell changes nothing; all 8 winning lines (3 rows, 3 columns, 2 diagonals) are detected; a full board with no line is a draw; after a win or draw further clicks change nothing until Restart; Restart empties the board and X moves first again. Put the pure game logic in a <script id="game-logic"> that does not touch the DOM and defines createGame() returning {board, current, winner, play(index), reset()}, and the DOM wiring in a second <script>. Plan four separate tasks: (1) contract: SPEC.md with the DOM hooks, the createGame API and the test plan; (2) implementation: index.html; (3) tests: tests/game.test.js using only node:test, node:assert, node:fs and node:vm that loads the game-logic script from index.html and tests alternation, all 8 lines, draw, occupied cells, moves after game over and reset, verified with `node --test tests/game.test.js`; (4) a read-only review of index.html and the tests.
